claims.statement: For every regular shifted wall, each separating ball is root-free below delta=d_i+k_i and has exactly one simple root at or above that threshold, with an exact valuation law.
For j=5 the counts are 0,0,2,3,3,5 at distances 1,...,6, and remain five for all larger distances. Every ball and every original admissible row is covered.
For j=2^a the wall has zero dyadic roots before distance j-1 and exactly j simple roots from that distance onward, within positive post-wall distances.
Every shifted wall has all j simple roots once delta>=v2((j-1)!)+ceil(log2(j)); positive post-wall distances understood.
The first irregular wall j=17 is certified for distances 1,...,19; the general theorem covers every distance >=20.
Every r>=1 has a unique finite monic Weierstrass factor of degree max(J_r)<=floor((s2(r)-1)/3), carrying the entire residual valuation.
Regular-wall pre-wall/equality scales and all j=17 scales 5<=L<=53 are resolved. All shifted-wall labels j<=32 are covered for every valid integer L with 2^L>j.
An explicit classification of all roots for every irregular wall and arbitrary r is not supplied. No universal simple-root statement is claimed.
No Lean or other proof-assistant checking performed in this release.
